faqs.question: When is the Khao Yai Marathon 2027 taking place?
faqs.answer: The B-Quik Khao Yai Marathon 2027 is scheduled to take place on January 10, 2027. The event will be held in Pak Chong, Nakhon Ratchasima, Thailand, and will include multiple race distances for participants to choose from, including a full marathon option.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Khao Yai Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Khao Yai Marathon offers three distance options for participants: a full marathon at 42.195km, a half marathon at 21.1km, and a shorter 10km race. This range allows runners of different experience levels and goals to participate in the same event.

faqs.question: Where is the Khao Yai Marathon held?
faqs.answer: The Khao Yai Marathon is held in Pak Chong, located in Nakhon Ratchasima, Thailand. This location places the race within the broader Khao Yai region, a well-known area in the country, and serves as the host venue for the 2027 edition of the event.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the Khao Yai Marathon 2027?
